overview: A one-page Department of State list-of-papers sheet for the Kwantung Leased Territory postal file records a communication dated November 1, 1937, from Grummon at Dairen to the Department’s Far Eastern office. The indexed communication concerned local postal authorities’ attempted interference with letters that foreigners in Dairen were sending to China and specifically reported the case of William A. Morgan, the Dairen representative of the American firm Frazer Federal.

subfiles.about: The sheet indexes a report about local postal authorities attempting to interfere with foreigners’ letters from Dairen to China.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State filing sheet records a November 1, 1937 communication from Grummon at Dairen to the Far Eastern office. The report concerned attempted interference by local postal authorities with mail sent to China by foreigners residing in Dairen. It highlighted the case of William A. Morgan, identified as the Dairen representative of Frazer Federal, U.S.A.

interest: Although the substantive report is not present, this index sheet supplies evidence of official American concern over postal surveillance or censorship in Japanese-controlled Dairen in 1937. Its reference to a named American company representative may help researchers locate related consular correspondence or reconstruct the practical constraints imposed on foreign residents’ communications in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
